messages:
karen: Quick sync — City Hackathon next week. We sponsor, have a 6x8 booth, one speaker slot, and a small workshop. Need to lock swag, speaking submission, and a webinar follow-up plan.

maya: Thanks — timeline?

karen: Load-in Fri 10am, doors 12pm, talk Sat 2pm. Swag needs to arrive by Thu EOD.

jon: Courier update: our local partner can do Thu morning pickup from warehouse. Tracking ETA Thu 14:00 if we label now.

maya: Current swag list: 200 stickers, 150 tee shirts (S-XL mix), 50 microfiber laptop sleeves, 100 promo cards with QR lead form. Can we cut tees to 120? shirts are heavy for courier.

karen: Cut tees to 120 ok. Priorities: stickers + sleeves + cards. Tees only for demo leads and speaker + 2 staff.

devin: Speaker asks: projector, mic, table power. I can bring a thunderbolt hub and one macbook. pls confirm power strips.

jon: I have 2x 6ft power strips reserved. I need headcount for booth staff shifts for Friday setup and Sat demo.

maya: Shifts: setup Fri 10–1: @devin + @jon, shift A Sat 11–3: @karen + @maya, shift B Sat 3–7: @devin + volunteer TBD.

sam: Messaging / benchmark narrative: we should have a one-pager comparing Redwood latency/cost vs managed endpoints for a 2k token prompt. I can draft a lightweight benchmark sheet and QR link to download.

karen: Yes — keep it simple: 3 charts (p90 latency, cost per 1k tokens, model variants). Add 2 short customer blurbs about reliability.

sam: Will draft and post to drive by Wed. Also we need two social launch posts: prep tweet thread + LinkedIn post to go out Mon following event with link to benchmark and webinar sign-up.

maya: Webinar follow-up plan: 1) immediate email to scanned leads with 'thanks' + CTA to webinar signup, 2) nurture drip (day 3: benchmark sheet, day 7: deep-dive demo recording). Need the landing page and form.

karen: Landing page URL -> replace with final shortlink at time of send. For now use: https://redwood.ai/hackathon-followup-draft

sam: Lead routing: scan QR cards into Typeform -> Zap to HubSpot -> assign owner by geographic tag (city hackathon) -> create 'event: City Hackathon 2026' contact property. Who owns field triage?

devin: I'll own triage for replies and demo requests for 72 hours post-event. Please assign HubSpot owner to me (devin@redwood.ai).

jon: Courier-bot: pickup scheduled.

courier-bot: Pickup confirmed. Pickup window Thu 08:00–12:00. Tracking: CB-2198.

maya: Speaking submission status: submitted last week, accepted — 20 minute talk + 10 Qs. Need slide deck review and 3 talking bullets.

karen: Slide owner: @sam. Sam, can you do a 45-min rehearsal for speaker content? We only have 20 min but want a dry run Friday AM.

sam: I can do a 30-min dry run Fri 8:30am. Will compress to 20.

maya: Checklist before Thu EOD (action owners):
- Final swag counts sent to courier (jon)
- QR lead card print + laminate (maya)
- Benchmark one-pager draft (sam)
- Landing page draft & form (sam)
- HubSpot zap + owner assignment (karen)
- Speaker slides branch + rehearsal (sam + devin)

karen: Also marketing ops: we need post-event webinar date set — propose Wed following the event at 11am PT. If that works I'll open calendar invite and promo.

devin: Wed 11am PT works for me. I can demo the product and take live Qs.

maya: Small ops note: booth backdrop print needs 'Redwood Inference' full logo on center + sponsor line. PDF to vendor sent, proof expected Wed morning.

sam: For social copy iteration: draft 3 variants for the post-event tweet thread:
1) Data-first — highlight benchmark numbers
2) Human-story — one customer blurb about moving to Redwood Dedicated
3) Product-first — demo highlight + CTA to webinar
We'll A/B test via boosted posts.

karen: Good. Sam, also draft 1 sentence elevator pitch for booth staff to use when talking with attendees (20 words max).

sam: Draft elevator pitch: "Redwood Inference: predictable, low-latency LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — built for production."

maya: Lead capture UX: QR card -> form asks: name, email, company, role, interest (demo / pricing / tech deep-dive). Add quick checkbox: "interested in webinar" default checked.

karen: Make sure privacy notice: "We store your info to follow up about this event" and unsubscribe link in emails.

jon: One more: swag security. Keep tees and sleeves locked in courier bag behind booth until noon. Give 1 staffer the key.

devin: I'll take key for first shift.

maya: Final outstanding: volunteer for Sat shift B. @all — ping if you can cover 3–7.

karen: thanks team. I'll update this thread when drafts are in drive. If anyone hits blockers call 415-555-0123 (ops line).

sam: I'll upload benchmark draft by Wed 18:00 PT.

maya: proof for backdrop in drive by Wed 09:00.

jon: Updated tracking CB-2198 -> pickup confirmed. ETA Thu 14:05.
